model_name: UrjaSetu Empirical Solar Temperature Penalty Model
dataset_location: Gandikota, Kadapa District, Andhra Pradesh, India

dataset_plants.name: Gandikota Solar Plant 1 (Kadapa District, Andhra Pradesh, India)
Gandikota Solar Plant 2 (Kadapa District, Andhra Pradesh, India)

temperature_penalty.comparison_explanation: Empirical regression from Gandikota SCADA operational data yields gamma = -0.533%/°C (90% CI: [-0.744, -0.295]), compared to the standard manufacturer datasheet nominal rating of -0.380%/°C, reflecting real-world utility operating losses including inverter clipping and balance-of-system thermal bottlenecks.

coupling_factor_alpha.description: Urban microclimate coupling coefficient scaling radiometric land surface temperature excess to rooftop PV module operating temperature.

limitations: Trained on 34 days of operational SCADA and weather sensor data (May 15 - June 17, 2020) from two utility-scale solar plants in Gandikota, Kadapa District, Andhra Pradesh, India.
Not Pune-specific: Pune urban microclimates have distinct convective wind patterns, humidity profiles, atmospheric aerosol optical depths, and rooftop boundary layer turbulence.
Relative output loss only: does NOT predict absolute kWh solar generation for Pune cells without site-specific panel tilt, orientation, inverter sizing, and clipping factors.
Surface temperature (LST) is radiometric skin temperature, NOT PV module surface temperature or ambient 2m air temperature.

disclaimers: Surface temperature (LST) is radiometric skin temperature, NOT 2m air temperature.
NDVI is a spectral vegetation reflectance index, NOT 3D canopy cover or shading.
Do NOT present absolute kWh for Pune; only relative percentage efficiency derating from local heat excess.
Unknown values stay null and show 'Not available'.
